Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback, the service is healthy in all regions with an error rate of ~0.2%. Follow-up: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 health check failures before any attempted re-release.
args.title: checkout-api healthy after rollout of v2.3.1 — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosis:** The latest deploy of checkout-api, **v2.3.1**, was failing health checks across all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
2. **Rollback:** Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production — in all regions. Confirmed post-rollback: service is **healthy** with an error rate down to ~0.2%.
3. **Incident:** Opened a **SEV2** incident for checkout-api documenting the failure, the rollback, and the follow-up to investigate the root cause of v2.3.1's health check failures. The on-call engineer has been paged.
